bayts.text: The All-Aware (Al-Khabīr) and the Great (Al-Kabīr) have extended to me gifts that never perish.
The beloved of my Lord is my intimate friend and my love: with the beloved my desire has been purified.
He erased my infirmity, the Effacer of my straying, Who makes my lawful gain grow without end.
The praise of the Last to Come has purified my life, and led a rank to me, with solicitude.
My nearness endures at my own soil, without exile and without toil.
My gratitude heads toward the Appreciative (Ash-Shakūr), for the grateful one (the Prophet), vessel of my praise.
Toward the God-fearing one, lion against the wretched, gate of ascent, my call is directed.
There has not come to my heart a caller to deceit, nor a caller to despoiling, nor a caller to disease.
O best of servants, your precedence is manifest from the beginnings, for whoever follows the example.
Yours is manifestation, from you come the dowries; yours are the supports on the day of concealment.
O lord of the squadrons (against) the unrepentant: for the best of the penitent, from you is healing.
Yours are my letters, from you my circumstances, with the spreading shade, O lord of gifts.
The tongue of my gratitude, after my remembrance, without guile, (goes) to the Lord of benefits.
To Peace (As-Salām) I convey my speech, without blame and without aversion.
I direct my tongue, with fair things, to Him Who clothed me in the garment of exaltation.
It has appeared to me that guidance is mine, without the dispute of those who come to their senses.
Allah, my Lord, has increased my love for Him and my deep drinking, together with my quenching.
He is the Generous, through Whom I seek what does not depart once attained.
He removed the cause of my complaint, after I leaned (on Him), without weeping and without remedy.
To Him my praise, in my hardship, without bending toward dispute.
To Him I have headed, and I have not erred, nor inclined toward a hypocrite.
He annihilated my temptations, the Giver of the (sacred) texts, together with firmness, without rashness.
He guided the disciple, repelled the rebel: what an excellent Unique One, Who makes my wealth grow!
I have directed my gratitude to the Giver of the Remembrance, without guile, for the benefits.
